data.one_liner: Create, format, and manipulate Excel documents programmatically in Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a non-UI library to generate and modify Excel (XLSX) spreadsheets natively in Dart. It supports cell values, built-in styles, formulas, charts, images, hyperlinks, and data importing.
use_when: You need to generate Excel spreadsheets dynamically inside a Flutter app.
You need to export reports or tabular data to XLSX format.
You want to manipulate cell styles, formulas, and charts programmatically.
avoid_when: You are not willing to acquire a commercial or free community license from Syncfusion.
You only need to deal with general file picking or saving without generating Excel files.
strengths: Feature-rich Excel generation supporting formulas, charts, and images.
High-performance and runs completely non-UI natively in Dart.
weaknesses: Requires a paid commercial or community license from Syncfusion.
Imperative programming model can require verbose code for complex spreadsheets.
